answer.reason: The verses state two deeds of Sheshbazzar beyond his office: bringing up the temple vessels and laying the temple's foundation.

clauses.english: brought up the temple vessels of gold and silver from Babylon to Jerusalem
clauses.quote: All these did Sheshbazzar bring up with them of the captivity

clauses.english: laid the foundation of the house of God in Jerusalem
clauses.quote: came the same Sheshbazzar, and laid the foundation of the house of God
